Create one production concept image for the Career World skill building "Operator control". This is a compact supporting skill structure: highly detailed and distinctive, smaller than project landmarks and much smaller than city capitals. Research-grounded domain summary: A human-in-the-loop systems capability that makes current state, intent, risk, thresholds, irreversible boundaries, confirmation, override, pause, rollback, and recovery legible before an operator commits an action. Accepted baseline identity: A raised faceted control cabin sits above a broad stepped plinth, reached by two exposed switchback ramps and backed by a low counterweight hall.
